actions.name: Use
actions.area: several living creatures within a 40-ft.-radius burst

description.summary: This spell snuffs out the life force of living creatures, killing them instantly
description.value: This spell snuffs out the life force of living creatures, killing them instantly. The spell slays 1d4 HD worth of living creatures per caster level (maximum 20d4). Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first; among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the burst’s point of origin are affected first. No creature of 9 or more HD can be affected, and HD that is not sufficient to affect a creature is wasted.
